import io.github.dsheirer.dsp.filter.FilterFactory;
import io.github.dsheirer.dsp.filter.fir.FIRFilterSpecification;
import io.github.dsheirer.dsp.filter.fir.real.RealFIRFilter;
import io.github.dsheirer.dsp.psk.demod.DifferentialDemodulatorFloatScalar;
import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class GenDsp {
    static Random rnd = new Random(77L);
    static String hex(float[] a) {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) sb.append(i > 0 ? "," : "").append(Integer.toHexString(Float.floatToRawIntBits(a[i])));
        return sb.toString();
    }
    static float[] noise(int n) { float[] a = new float[n]; for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) a[i] = (float) (rnd.nextGaussian() * 0.5); return a; }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(new FileWriter(args[0]));
        // RRC taps: (samplesPerSymbol, symbols, alpha)
        double[][] rrc = {{25000.0 / 4800, 16, 0.2}, {38400.0 / 4800, 16, 0.2}, {19200.0 / 4800, 16, 0.2}, {50000.0 / 4800, 16, 0.2}, {8, 10, 0.35}};
        for (double[] p : rrc) {
            float[] t = FilterFactory.getRootRaisedCosine(p[0], (int) p[1], (float) p[2]);
            out.println("RRC|" + p[0] + "," + (int) p[1] + "," + (float) p[2] + "|" + hex(t));
        }
        // Streaming FIR with varying block sizes.
        float[] taps = FilterFactory.getRootRaisedCosine(25000.0 / 4800, 16, 0.2f);
        RealFIRFilter fir = new RealFIRFilter(taps.clone());
        for (int blk : new int[]{64, 64, 100, 37, 64, 256}) {
            float[] in = noise(blk);
            out.println("FIR|" + hex(taps) + ";" + hex(in) + "|" + hex(fir.filter(in)));
        }
        // Differential demodulator, 25 kHz and 38.4 kHz, streaming blocks.
        for (double sr : new double[]{25000, 38400, 19200}) {
            DifferentialDemodulatorFloatScalar d = new DifferentialDemodulatorFloatScalar(sr, 4800);
            for (int blk : new int[]{50, 50, 80, 31, 200}) {
                float[] i = noise(blk), q = noise(blk);
                out.println("DEMOD|" + sr + ";" + hex(i) + ";" + hex(q) + "|" + hex(d.demodulate(i, q)));
            }
        }
        // Baseband low-pass design (Remez) used by the C4FM decoder, per decimated sample rate.
        for (double sr : new double[]{25000, 38400, 19200, 24000, 48000}) {
            FIRFilterSpecification spec = FIRFilterSpecification.lowPassBuilder().sampleRate(sr)
                .passBandCutoff(5200).passBandAmplitude(1.0).passBandRipple(0.01)
                .stopBandAmplitude(0.0).stopBandStart(6500).stopBandRipple(0.01).build();
            float[] t = FilterFactory.getTaps(spec);
            out.println("BASEBAND|" + sr + "|" + hex(t));
        }
        out.close();
    }
}
